semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the claim that enabling tools substantially improves Grok 4's HLE performance.

contract.note: Assessing the combined toolkit is an ordinary reading of the cited launch comparison. It does not establish that code execution alone causes the gain.

evidence.note: Reports ordinary Grok 4 improving from 25.4% to 38.6% with tools, separately identifying Heavy. These are reported company results, not independent replication; inference settings are incompletely documented.
Identifies the combined Python and Internet toolkit and distinguishes full-set results from the text-only training graph. The readable excerpt supplies no numerical comparison.

reviews.rationale: The reported launch comparison shows a substantial 13.2 percentage-point improvement for ordinary Grok 4 with the combined toolkit, satisfying the contract's permitted reporting standard. Support is limited to that configuration: code-only causation, matched inference budgets, and independent replication are not established, and the training graph uses a different question subset.
